data: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2023, Microsoft reported revenue of $211,915 million (about $211.9 billion) and net income of $72,361 million (about $72.4 billion). Revenue in fiscal 2022 was $198,270 million, so fiscal 2023 revenue grew by roughly 6.9%, an increase of $13,645 million. Net income edged down slightly from $72,738 million in fiscal 2022, a decline of about 0.5%, as the provision for income taxes rose from $10,978 million to $16,950 million.
